proposed_widenings.name: detect.property: "hostile_creatures"
proposed_widenings.justification: The wand's core mechanic is sensing the presence of hostile creatures within range. The detect atom exists and is the right shape, but its property enum is closed to magic/evil_and_good/poison_and_disease/thoughts — no variant for enemy/hostile-creature detection.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 feet

proposed_widenings.name: detect.directional: true (or directional output field)
proposed_widenings.justification: The wand provides directional knowledge (direction yes, distance no) rather than omniscient awareness of all matching creatures in the radius. The current detect atom has only radiusFeet with no way to express that the output is a direction-only sense toward the nearest qualifying creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you

proposed_widenings.name: detect.nearestOnly: true
proposed_widenings.justification: The wand identifies only the nearest hostile, not all hostiles in range. The detect atom has no field to express a nearest-only scope vs sensing all qualifying entities in the radius.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 feet

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger: "holder_stops_holding_item"
proposed_widenings.justification: The 1-minute effect ends early when the holder stops holding the wand. No DurationEndTrigger variant models an item-holding-state change as a duration-end condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect ends if you stop holding the wand.

notes: The overall structure encodes cleanly: ActivatedAbilityMechanics with a 7-charge pool (cap fixed 7, dawn regain 1d6+1), standard_action magic cost, timed 1-minute duration, holding_item condition, last_charge_roll destruction (d20 destroyOn=1). The sole blocker is the detect atom — it needs 'hostile_creatures' as a property variant plus directional/nearest-only output fields. No new top-level atom or family is required.
